03ef835985eb51a0.en: The submitted application under the simplified procedure. No extension or special exceptions apply. Counting rules for this exercise: from the day after the event; a non-working final day is moved forward; the federal five-day working week applies.
03ef835985eb51a0.zh: 已按简化程序提交的申请。不存在延期或特别例外。本练习的计时规则：从事件发生次日起算；截止日为非工作日时顺延；采用联邦五天工作周。

0f71118a6d4d70fd.en: Article 88(2) of the Russian Tax Code; Article 221.1 of the Russian Tax Code
0f71118a6d4d70fd.zh: 俄罗斯税法典第88条第2款；俄罗斯税法典第221.1条

9a94c46886504643.en: Final day for reviewing the simplified application
9a94c46886504643.zh: 简化申请核查的截止日

9e371ada9d4aea74.en: The other tax scenarios involve submitted tax returns. This one concerns a simplified application; the appearance of its draft does not start the review.
9e371ada9d4aea74.zh: 其他税务情境中提交的是纳税申报表。本案适用简化申请，草稿的出现并不启动核查。

a0a654080f6c3d63.en: A three-month period is stated for an ordinary tax return without special conditions. The guide does not describe application У-4.
a0a654080f6c3d63.zh: 对于没有特殊条件的普通纳税申报表，说明规定了三个月的期限。该指南并不涉及申请У-4。

a15c92ffb19ab311.en: The pre-filled document was generated on {{draft}}. It was not signed or submitted before {{statement}}.
a15c92ffb19ab311.zh: 预填文件于{{draft}}生成。在{{statement}}之前尚未签署或提交。

69578ab352cd6795.en: An eligible application under Article 221.1 was signed and submitted on {{statement}}. It is not a 3-NDFL tax return. No extension of the review applies in this case.
69578ab352cd6795.zh: 符合第221.1条规定的申请于{{statement}}签署并提交。这不是3-NDFL纳税申报表。本案不适用核查延期。

fda5dc335a401e9d.en: Draft: {{draft}}; submitted application: {{statement}}. The letter was received on {{received}} and registered on {{registered}}.
fda5dc335a401e9d.zh: 草稿日期为{{draft}}，提交申请日期为{{statement}}。信件于{{received}}收到，于{{registered}}登记。

9043e03b2e4a50ca.en: The period is tied to submission of the application, not the appearance of its draft; the procedure differs from that for an ordinary 3-NDFL return. The other tax scenarios involve submitted tax returns. This one concerns a simplified application; the appearance of its draft does not start the review.
9043e03b2e4a50ca.zh: 期限与提交申请有关，而不是与草稿出现有关；该程序不同于普通3-NDFL纳税申报。其他税务情境中提交的是纳税申报表。本案适用简化申请，草稿的出现并不启动核查。

7e38b9d2ab167ce7.en: The period is tied to submission of the application, not the appearance of its draft; the procedure differs from that for an ordinary 3-NDFL return.
7e38b9d2ab167ce7.zh: 期限与提交申请有关，而不是与草稿出现有关；该程序不同于普通3-NDFL纳税申报。

fc4b708e49896275.en: The appearance of any draft is equivalent to submission.
fc4b708e49896275.zh: 任何草稿的出现都等同于提交。

a967a4fa58aa847c.en: Every tax deduction is reviewed for exactly three calendar months.
a967a4fa58aa847c.zh: 任何税收扣除都只按三个日历月进行核查。

0a842dd99f313775.en: Completion of one stage does not prove completion of another.
0a842dd99f313775.zh: 一个阶段完成并不能证明另一个阶段已经完成。

52b54afb85b51e9a.en: The online account now says “review completed”, but there is no confirmation of a transfer yet.
52b54afb85b51e9a.zh: 个人账户中出现了“核查已完成”的标记，但尚无转账确认。

4ea8083b62e00f5d.en: Distinguish the review result from the transfer; establish the next status without inventing a payment date.
4ea8083b62e00f5d.zh: 区分核查结果与转账；核实下一阶段状态，不虚构付款日期。

26b924bf2b483cbd.en: State that the money has already been credited because the review has finished.
26b924bf2b483cbd.zh: 因核查已经结束，就告知款项已到账。

1afb0f3d0bed6179.en: Restart the full three-month period from the date of every question the citizen asks.
1afb0f3d0bed6179.zh: 每次公民提出问题，都从当天重新计算完整的三个月。

8213acb6d2eef94b.en: Article 221.1 of Part Two of the Russian Tax Code governs simplified deductions on application through an online account. A pre-filled application left as a draft and a signed, submitted application are different events. The review period is set by Article 88(2) of Part One of the Russian Tax Code: 30 calendar days unless statutory exceptions apply. In this exercise the application is eligible and has been submitted, with no extension; the date of the money transfer is not calculated.
8213acb6d2eef94b.zh: 俄罗斯税法典第二部分第221.1条规定通过个人账户申请的简化扣除程序。保留为草稿的预填申请，与签署并提交的申请，是不同的事件。申请的核查期限由俄罗斯税法典第一部分第88条第2款规定：如未适用法定例外，为30个日历日。本练习中申请符合要求且已提交，不存在延期；不计算款项转账日期。

ecb8e6a5f0d05632.en: Distinguish an application under the simplified procedure from an unsigned draft.
ecb8e6a5f0d05632.zh: 区分简化程序申请与未签署的草稿。

135999fdec69e251.en: Treat every draft as automatically submitted.
135999fdec69e251.zh: 认为任何草稿都已自动提交。

a096b22588e0b42b.en: Equate the standard review period with a guarantee that the entire amount will be refunded.
a096b22588e0b42b.zh: 将标准核查期限等同于全额退税的保证。

6f03fec524da59d8.en: Find the rule: Application for a deduction under the simplified procedure. Specify the act's details and article, then select the applicable provision.
6f03fec524da59d8.zh: 查找规范：简化程序下的扣除申请。注明法律文件信息及条款，然后选择适用规定。

fdf3230242b13b3f.en: The application appeared in my online account a long time ago. I signed it later, but the waiting period starts when it appeared, right?
fdf3230242b13b3f.zh: 申请很早就出现在我的个人账户里。我后来才签署，但等待时间应该从它出现时开始算，对吗？

b6e217be82116f5b.en: A simplified deduction under Article 221.1, with the application reviewed under Article 88 of the Russian Tax Code.
b6e217be82116f5b.zh: 依据第221.1条进行简化扣除，并依据俄罗斯税法典第88条核查申请。

0998a4676d718223.en: An ordinary initial tax return, which is absent from this case.
0998a4676d718223.zh: 本案中不存在的普通首次纳税申报表。

7950592b4daff3a4.en: A response to a submission under 59-ФЗ instead of a review of the application.
7950592b4daff3a4.zh: 以依据59-ФЗ回复来函代替核查申请。

b91541a5419da99d.en: No, it was a pre-filled draft.
b91541a5419da99d.zh: 没有，那是一份预填草稿。

d80d52ce9907f4d0.en: A draft is not the same as a submitted application.
d80d52ce9907f4d0.zh: 草稿不等于已提交的申请。

96e32d4fa17ce3ea.en: There is a date of legally significant submission.
96e32d4fa17ce3ea.zh: 存在具有法律意义的提交日期。

9d4b063690f18ed9.en: When did you sign and submit the application?
9d4b063690f18ed9.zh: 您何时签署并提交了申请？

10ac66a18af6f596.en: No, it is specifically an application under the simplified procedure.
10ac66a18af6f596.zh: 不是，确实是简化程序下的申请。

00b41b5a923a4b25.en: Is this an ordinary 3-NDFL tax return?
00b41b5a923a4b25.zh: 这是普通3-NDFL纳税申报表吗？

99e2ace4c880dd15.en: No; under the conditions, it does not apply to this review.
99e2ace4c880dd15.zh: 没有；按照题设，本次核查不适用延期。

06715608f307f344.en: The exercise uses the standard thirty-day period.
06715608f307f344.zh: 本题适用标准的三十日期限。

5abbf3c957c2df09.en: Specialist preparing an explanation of the simplified deduction
5abbf3c957c2df09.zh: 负责准备简化扣除说明的工作人员

031b8369569b6cab.en: The tax authority's unit responsible for the application concerned.
031b8369569b6cab.zh: 税务机关负责该申请的部门。

5ccdec3e7bdccad2.en: The bank as the authority approving the tax deduction amount.
5ccdec3e7bdccad2.zh: 作为批准税收扣除金额机关的银行。

5f93e2abe9e0f01c.en: The interface administrator as the person deciding the tax claim.
5f93e2abe9e0f01c.zh: 作为裁决税务请求人员的界面管理员。

bfc9a1217d155747.en: The draft appeared before the application

1217eacf828cf29d.en: Article 221.1 is in Part Two, and Article 88 is in Part One. These are not different dates of the same part of the Code.
1217eacf828cf29d.zh: 第221.1条位于第二部分，第88条位于第一部分。这不是同一部法典同一部分的不同日期。

43f628dc8cb99f19.en: The simplified application is provided for in Part Two of the Russian Tax Code; its review period must be checked separately in Part One.
43f628dc8cb99f19.zh: 简化申请由俄罗斯税法典第二部分规定；其核查期限须另行在第一部分中查核。

d9fbff3e42470326.en: Promptly forward the confirmed report to the designated duty officer
d9fbff3e42470326.zh: 迅速将已确认的信息转交指定值班人员

53e929798686b22a.en: Arrange safe access restrictions and a specialist inspection through those responsible
53e929798686b22a.zh: 通过负责人安排安全的接近限制及专业检查

85243b5bec179c71.en: Continue the separate consideration of the written submission
85243b5bec179c71.zh: 继续单独办理书面来函

17f20f475b102dfe.en: Do not require the applicant to approach the damaged branch
17f20f475b102dfe.zh: 不要要求申请人靠近受损树枝

004fb7798e5b1a58.en: Check the safety of the detour and confirmation of subsequent risk removal
004fb7798e5b1a58.zh: 检查绕行路线的安全性，并核实后续消除风险的确认信息

5c848a24f262dbd9.en: Postpone urgent forwarding until the general response deadline
5c848a24f262dbd9.zh: 将紧急转交推迟至一般回复期限

2cad60952307a086.en: Ask the resident to saw or inspect the branch herself
2cad60952307a086.zh: 要求居民自行锯切或检查树枝

5b914d255a228352.en: Ask the resident to saw or inspect the branch herself: the action exceeds the stated authority or creates an unjustified risk.
5b914d255a228352.zh: 要求居民自行锯切或检查树枝：该行为超出规定权限，或造成不合理风险。

6d3c3845434909bf.en: After strong wind, a large branch on tree Д-31 is damaged above a passage in use. The duty officer's record confirms that the report is current. Responsible specialists, not the student, determine the danger area's boundary and the measures required.
6d3c3845434909bf.zh: 刮风后，树木Д-31的一根大树枝受损，位于正在使用的通道上方。值班记录确认该信息仍然有效。危险区域边界及措施由负责的专业人员确定，而非学生。

274779973361f7fc.en: The territorial duty officer and the specialist vegetation inspection service have been designated. Safe access restrictions and a professional assessment are being arranged. The game simulates messages and does not send them to real services.
274779973361f7fc.zh: 已确定辖区值班人员和负责绿化检查的专业服务机构。正在安排安全的接近限制与专业评估。游戏仅模拟信息，不向真实服务机构发送信息。

c988f080cc207e61.en: A routine courtyard inspection is scheduled for later. The schedule does not cancel the need to respond to new damage and is not permission to fell the entire tree.
c988f080cc207e61.zh: 庭院例行检查安排在较晚时间。该计划并不免除对新损坏作出反应的必要性，也不是砍伐整棵树的许可。

fcd0d301c597fde5.en: The current damage requires prompt forwarding and protection of the passage within the relevant authority; specialists determine how further work is done. The original scenario checked the basis for removal already carried out. Here the damage creates a current danger: protection and a professional assessment come first, not waiting for paperwork.
fcd0d301c597fde5.zh: 当前损坏要求及时转交信息，并在相应权限内保护通道；后续作业方式由专业人员决定。原情境核查的是已经完成的清除作业的依据。本案的损坏造成现时危险：应先采取防护并进行专业评估，而不是等待书面手续。

45ca037118c8dcc9.en: The current damage requires prompt forwarding and protection of the passage within the relevant authority; specialists determine how further work is done.
45ca037118c8dcc9.zh: 当前损坏要求及时转交信息，并在相应权限内保护通道；后续作业方式由专业人员决定。

228fd7792e0c9170.en: Any danger involving a tree obliges the reception office to decide independently that it must be felled completely.
228fd7792e0c9170.zh: 任何树木危险都意味着接待处必须自行决定将整棵树砍伐。

4fd38ec6f227586b.en: Restrictions on a dangerous passage cannot be arranged before the written response.
4fd38ec6f227586b.zh: 在书面回复前，不得安排对危险通道的限制措施。

e149c1dfc726c5dd.en: Forward the new information to the responsible duty officer and check the safety of the temporary route. This is a new circumstance or incomplete confirmation; the previous conclusion does not replace checking it.
e149c1dfc726c5dd.zh: 将新信息转交负责的值班人员，并检查临时路线的安全性。这属于新情况或确认不完整，先前结论不能代替对此进行核查。

6300140fa8586ca7.en: Access to the dangerous area has been restricted, but the barrier directs pedestrians beneath another damaged branch.
6300140fa8586ca7.zh: 危险区域已限制接近，但围挡却把行人引向另一根受损树枝下方。

ee756c02a3b04bce.en: Forward the new information to the responsible duty officer and check the safety of the temporary route.
ee756c02a3b04bce.zh: 将新信息转交负责的值班人员，并检查临时路线的安全性。

24f49509f72fb80a.en: Close the issue because the initial barrier tape has already been installed.
24f49509f72fb80a.zh: 因最初的警戒带已设置，就结束处理。

7e13a2a3976b66dd.en: Suggest that the applicant move the barrier at her own risk.
7e13a2a3976b66dd.zh: 建议申请人自行承担责任移动围挡。

709f6ea5b3da9263.en: After the wind, a large damaged branch is hanging over the passage to the building. I submitted a letter, but nobody has restricted access yet. Must we wait for a reply to the letter?
709f6ea5b3da9263.zh: 刮风后，一根受损的大树枝悬在通往住宅的通道上方。我已经写了来函，但还没有人限制接近。必须等信件回复吗？

b4d2851d93e892d3.en: Consider only the legality of future removal, without forwarding information about the current danger.
b4d2851d93e892d3.zh: 只审查未来清除作业的合法性，不转交当前危险的信息。

5f7b6de103a87d4a.en: Wait for a routine inspection under the general submission procedure before forwarding the report about the dangerous area.
5f7b6de103a87d4a.zh: 先等待按一般来函程序开展的例行检查，再转交危险区域报告。

f8d1cd339dbd7628.en: Yes. The urgent inspection record confirms damage above an active pedestrian passage.
f8d1cd339dbd7628.zh: 是的。紧急检查记录确认，损坏位于正在使用的人行通道上方。

4267950f1fb4c32b.en: The ordinary correspondence deadline does not determine the timing of initial protection.
4267950f1fb4c32b.zh: 普通通信期限并不决定初步防护的时间。

02de85db042acb39.en: Does the danger still exist now?

bb76179ef0376fc8.en: The internal record designates a specialist service; a professional inspection is required.
bb76179ef0376fc8.zh: 内部记录已指定专业服务机构，需要进行专业检查。

62c427961274a452.en: The reception officer does not prescribe the removal method.
62c427961274a452.zh: 接待处工作人员不决定清除方式。

c6ae76464d19d974.en: Who is authorised to assess the tree's condition?

c6965400854dc432.en: Not yet. A report to the responsible duty officer and access restrictions within that officer's authority must be arranged.
c6965400854dc432.zh: 还没有。需要向负责的值班人员报告，并安排其权限范围内的通行限制。

b58c4bb09cc39a68.en: Prompt forwarding is needed, not dangerous evidence-gathering by the citizen.
b58c4bb09cc39a68.zh: 需要及时转交，而不是让公民冒险收集证据。

3e916632b99ec08e.en: Are safe access restrictions in place?
3e916632b99ec08e.zh: 是否已采取安全的接近限制措施？

7fe30917f4555503.en: The location is known from the record. I should not go beneath the branch or measure it.
7fe30917f4555503.zh: 记录中已明确地点。我不应该走到树枝下方或测量树枝。

63e2a06c2986b008.en: No additional inspection by the applicant is required.
63e2a06c2986b008.zh: 无需申请人进行额外检查。

64531be6ce9b23f1.en: Can you provide information without approaching it?
64531be6ce9b23f1.zh: 您能在不靠近的情况下提供信息吗？

1a22f25503dce451.zh: 城市公共事务值班专员

14b58962e0bbd2e2.en: First initiate urgent action by the responsible services, without independently deciding how much vegetation to remove.
14b58962e0bbd2e2.zh: 首先启动负责机构的紧急行动，不自行决定清除绿化植被的范围。

0432b5803c065f71.en: Request a felling permit as a prerequisite for the initial report about the overhanging branch.
0432b5803c065f71.zh: 将索取砍伐许可作为首次报告悬垂树枝的前提。

ff723f35508e3d34.en: Ask the visitor to remove the branch independently to reopen the passage.
ff723f35508e3d34.zh: 要求来访者自行清除树枝，以恢复通行。

7779d2afa955ddec.en: The original scenario checked the basis for removal already carried out. Here the damage creates a current danger: protection and a professional assessment come first, not waiting for paperwork.
7779d2afa955ddec.zh: 原情境核查的是已经完成的清除作业的依据。本案的损坏造成现时危险：应先采取防护并进行专业评估，而不是等待书面手续。

125e494f3b4ba087.en: Assistant: “The routine schedule rules out an unscheduled response even when new damage occurs.”
125e494f3b4ba087.zh: 助手：“即使出现新的损坏，例行计划也排除了计划外反应。”

57551fdbfbe362f8.en: Compare the work location with the document and map
57551fdbfbe362f8.zh: 对照文件和地图核查作业地点

6f2afe657f28e441.en: Identify the specialist authority for the territory and type of work
6f2afe657f28e441.zh: 根据区域和作业类型确定主管机关

050b0a4b725b7c62.en: Prepare to forward the submission, identifying the mismatch between the plots
050b0a4b725b7c62.zh: 准备转送来函，并指出地块不一致的问题

3e929dff9557e261.en: Notify the applicant without a premature finding of guilt
3e929dff9557e261.zh: 通知申请人，不过早作出有罪结论

7669f0234ade03b7.en: Check that the response concerns plot А specifically
7669f0234ade03b7.zh: 核查回复是否确实针对地块А

d67243d1db905b15.en: Suggest that the applicant physically block the machinery
d67243d1db905b15.zh: 建议申请人亲自阻挡机械作业

ba3a44a647726a72.en: Conceal the plot mismatch in the materials being forwarded
ba3a44a647726a72.zh: 在转交材料中隐瞒地块不一致的问题

a4a62be53d1868df.en: Calculate the deadline for forwarding a copy of the submission to the proper addressee. This is not a universal deadline for resolving the problem. In this exercise counting begins on the day after the initial event; a non-working final day is moved to the next working day.
a4a62be53d1868df.zh: 计算将来函副本转交适当收件机关的截止日期。这不是解决问题的通用期限。本练习从起始事件的次日起算；截止日为非工作日时顺延至下一工作日。

c71bc1c3ef35abf9.en: The deadline for the specified action on the submission: 59-ФЗ, Article 8. Other sector-specific rules are used to decide the merits, not as the source of this deadline. The counting rules are set out separately in the conditions.
c71bc1c3ef35abf9.zh: 针对来函采取指定行动的期限：59-ФЗ第8条。其他行业规范用于实质处理，而不是该期限的依据。计时规则在题设中另行给出。

3c11c377dfda5823.en: Deadline for forwarding to the competent authority
3c11c377dfda5823.zh: 转送有管辖权机关的截止日期

a36bd85290bb2db8.en: The photographs show work on plot А. The document lists trees on plot Б. A permit for plot А is absent from the supplied set; this does not mean it does not exist.
a36bd85290bb2db8.zh: 照片显示地块А正在作业。文件列明的是地块Б的树木。所提供材料中没有地块А的许可；这并不意味着许可不存在。

48f4a886a3b19f30.en: The contractor claims that the document covers the whole block. There is no supporting annex.
48f4a886a3b19f30.zh: 承包商声称该文件适用于整个街区，但没有支持这一说法的附件。

7d618baa130455a2.en: The supplied document does not confirm a right to carry out work specifically on plot А; clarification is required.
7d618baa130455a2.zh: 所提供文件不能确认有权在地块А进行这些作业，需要进一步核实。

f928fa7d94ff642a.en: The copy authorises any work in this block.
f928fa7d94ff642a.zh: 该副本证明本街区任何作业均获许可。

580e3a9b89e11f55.en: The absence of a document from the letter already proves a crime.
580e3a9b89e11f55.zh: 信件中没有文件就已经证明犯罪。

7b0906f6243854e0.en: Training continuation. The response again encloses a document for plot Б.
7b0906f6243854e0.zh: 教学续篇。回复再次附上了地块Б的文件。

b2db74c23f9ca164.en: Identify the unresolved issue concerning plot А and arrange substantive clarification.
b2db74c23f9ca164.zh: 指出地块А的问题尚未解决，并安排实质性核实。

7064abaca3e54c78.en: Close the case after receiving the repeated document.
7064abaca3e54c78.zh: 收到重复文件后结束案件。

ba1aa4059622b4f3.en: Find the rule establishing the procedure and deadline for the action specified in the calendar exercise.
ba1aa4059622b4f3.zh: 查找规定日历任务中指定行动的程序与期限的规范。

2406d8d61d7bb104.en: Trees are being felled in the courtyard. The workers show a paper, but it seems to refer to a different plot. Someone in the chat has already written that everything is permitted.
2406d8d61d7bb104.zh: 院子里正在砍树。工人展示了一张纸，但上面似乎是另一个地块。聊天群里已经有人说一切都获准了。

6c29a35ff712452c.en: A submission about work on the territory, with identification of the relevant specialist authority
6c29a35ff712452c.zh: 关于区域内作业的来函，并确定相应专业管辖权

0cba0a57e39ee861.en: Issuance of a permit by a reception officer
0cba0a57e39ee861.zh: 由接待处工作人员签发许可

0f971ef65fb40069.en: I marked plot А on the diagram; the felling is visible there.
0f971ef65fb40069.zh: 我在示意图上标出了地块А，那里能看到砍伐。

8c49cd4e92aa685c.en: The observed location has been identified.

e159b06f35c5f540.en: The attached copy names plot Б, on the opposite side of the block.
e159b06f35c5f540.zh: 所附副本写的是地块Б，在街区另一侧。

c5ec10ce2da2cd3a.en: The document concerns a different site.

6b2787f8ed05eeb8.en: Which site is named in the document?
6b2787f8ed05eeb8.zh: 文件注明的是哪个地点？

20274773111b3476.en: The passage is fenced off. The case conditions do not report any current danger.
20274773111b3476.zh: 通道已围挡。题设未报告当前存在危险。

87cb84fd218ea512.en: The case does not require a simulated emergency call.
87cb84fd218ea512.zh: 本案不需要模拟紧急呼叫。

0c6924faad3644bc.en: Is there an immediate danger to people?
0c6924faad3644bc.zh: 是否对人员构成立即危险？

3b1060ffccd81df7.en: There is an outgoing reference and an authority name; authenticity and applicability need to be checked.
3b1060ffccd81df7.zh: 有发文标记和机关名称；需要核实真实性及适用性。

2b3c7a684cd66a90.en: A photocopy is no substitute for verification.

37af8b626e79ed28.en: Have the territory's owner and the issuing authority been identified?
37af8b626e79ed28.zh: 是否已确定该区域的所有人及发证机关？

57c83877c903bfee.en: Clarify the boundaries and the document for plot А, and forward the materials to the competent vegetation protection authority.
57c83877c903bfee.zh: 核实地块А的边界和文件，将材料转交有管辖权的绿化保护机关。

b12d184f84782162.en: Instruct the citizen to stop the machinery personally.
b12d184f84782162.zh: 要求公民亲自阻止机械作业。

f00179f227ada267.en: Approve the felling on behalf of the reception office.
f00179f227ada267.zh: 以接待处名义批准砍伐。

9fe22ca8ea35fd49.en: A permit for the neighbouring plot

73818334549b7802.en: Check whether it covers the site and work described in the submission.
73818334549b7802.zh: 核查其是否涵盖来函所述地点和作业。

b6f11be13a129ce1.en: Stop consideration as soon as the word “permit” appears.
b6f11be13a129ce1.zh: 看到“许可”一词就停止办理。

db6760d4f8f1dbd7.en: Assistant: “Since there is a permit, the complaint has no subject matter.”
db6760d4f8f1dbd7.zh: 助手：“既然有许可，投诉就没有实质问题。”

40e2815851379a28.en: Compare the numbers, location, type of work and validity of the authorising basis
40e2815851379a28.zh: 比对编号、地点、作业类型及授权依据的有效性

d3361c74eaa354e4.en: Check the act and the authorised unit's confirmation
d3361c74eaa354e4.zh: 核查正式文件及授权部门的确认

95ca3591e34c128a.en: Prepare a response on the established basis for the specific work
95ca3591e34c128a.zh: 就具体作业已查明的依据准备回复

ac6983b096bacdaf.en: Explain the available information and how to raise separate questions
ac6983b096bacdaf.zh: 解释可提供的信息及提出独立问题的程序

e0566ccd6d9a4e5c.en: Do not extend the conclusion to other trees or future work
e0566ccd6d9a4e5c.zh: 不将结论扩展至其他树木或未来作业

a2880948716ac0f4.en: Conclude that there is no permit because the applicant has no copy
a2880948716ac0f4.zh: 因申请人没有副本就认定没有许可

48cdb4c6240da5b0.en: Authorise further removal of any trees under the previous act
48cdb4c6240da5b0.zh: 依据原正式文件批准继续清除任何树木

d35757ba85fd5a80.en: Authorise further removal of any trees under the previous act: the action exceeds the stated authority or creates an unjustified risk.
d35757ba85fd5a80.zh: 依据原正式文件批准继续清除任何树木：该行为超出规定权限，或造成不合理风险。

1b807ee6cc4b5789.en: The submission disputes the removal of two trees, Д-14 and Д-15. Their location and numbers are confirmed by the accepted set of documents, not inferred from the species' appearance.
1b807ee6cc4b5789.zh: 来函对清除两棵树木Д-14和Д-15提出异议。地点和编号由已采纳的材料确认，并非根据树种外观判断。

b45ba7a07932e290.en: Location card and plan for Д-14/Д-15

38ea878b48134782.en: The authorised department confirmed a valid basis for removing Д-14 and Д-15; the assessment and act concern these trees. The conditions establish no departures in this work. These are synthetic materials, not a report about a real site.
38ea878b48134782.zh: 授权部门确认，清除Д-14和Д-15具有有效依据；结论和正式文件均涉及这两棵树。题设未认定这些作业存在偏差。这些是合成教学材料，并非真实地点的报告。

70dc82021b69e103.zh: 经核实的摘录与正式文件

3ec985964d3192e0.en: The neighbouring plot has different numbers. Its documents are not needed to substantiate this removal.
3ec985964d3192e0.zh: 邻近地块具有不同编号。确认本次清除无需使用其文件。

3b2b68a46e8bef85.en: In this set, the authorising basis and the completed work concern the same trees; the resident's lack of a copy does not prove that no permit exists. In the original version, the permit concerned another location. Here it is confirmed for the relevant trees, so the substantive response must change.
3b2b68a46e8bef85.zh: 在这套材料中，依据与已完成作业涉及的是同一批树木；居民没有副本不能证明没有许可。在原版本中，许可涉及另一个地点。本案已确认许可适用于相关树木，因此实质回复必须改变。

37d33d9f9cd7996f.en: In this set, the authorising basis and the completed work concern the same trees; the resident's lack of a copy does not prove that no permit exists.
37d33d9f9cd7996f.zh: 在这套材料中，依据与已完成作业涉及的是同一批树木；居民没有副本不能证明没有许可。

7d27bde9394b83ff.en: Any felling is unlawful if the applicant was not personally given a copy of the permit beforehand.
7d27bde9394b83ff.zh: 只要事先没有向申请人本人提供许可副本，任何砍伐都属违法。

7f45d0a6a1858492.en: One verified act authorises any further work throughout the courtyard.
7f45d0a6a1858492.zh: 一份经核实的正式文件就能授权整个庭院内的任何后续作业。
